_note: Kimi-K3 open-ended optimizer case: ONE MLA (dense full-attention) decoder layer of Kimi-K3 on sglang v0.5.20, B200, in the cookbook production shape (attention TP8 rank = 12 heads, cutedsl_mla decode backend with page 64 and fp8_e4m3 latent KV, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 routed experts). Metric = CUDA-graph replay time of the decode step. No PR answer key: improvement over the pristine tree + correctness (output + written KV row vs a seeded golden with planted high-norm keys).

render.METRIC: CUDA-graph decode-step latency of one Kimi-K3 MLA decoder layer
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one MLA (dense multi-head latent attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, cutedsl_mla decode over a paged fp8 latent KV, 112 local mxfp4 experts)
render.WORKLOAD: batched decode, one token per request per step: B=128 requests at context 8192 (primary), plus B=1 at context 1,048,576 and B=16 at 65,536 (must not regress)
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /tmp && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,8192 --attn-type mla --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attention-backend cutedsl_mla --attn-heads 12 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --experts 112 --ep 8 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
